{{Top|leg}}
'''Ch'hala tea''' was a type of [[Tea/Legends|tea]] that was made from the roots of the [[ch'hala tree]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] [[Haque]] and [[Zlash]] drank ch'hala tea together in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], while discussing the current situation in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. They drank the tea from [[devros crystal]] tea cups.<ref name="Wizard">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050310a|text=Simplicity}}</ref>
